description.en:
Starts fading a screen out to black over a number of frames. The call returns straight away; use CMND_IS_BLACK_FADE to wait for the fade to finish.

Screens use the public constants SCREEN_A (0, top screen), SCREEN_B (1, bottom screen) and SCREEN_AB (2, both).
While an event has its bottom-screen background loaded (the EvSubBg image the event system shows on the lower screen), a fade asked for SCREEN_A is applied to both screens instead.

The ev_main helper StartBlackFadeOut wraps this call together with the waiting loop.
Screen to fade: SCREEN_A (0), SCREEN_B (1) or SCREEN_AB (2).
Length of the fade in frames. The event scripts use the constants EV_FADE_QUICK (5), EV_FADE_NORMAL (10) and EV_FADE_SLOW (15).

examples.case: Fading to black and waiting for the fade (real usage, the body of ev_main's StartBlackFadeOut)
